report.title: Eight days in: the safety substrate is built, the product is still one module.
report.subject: Pediatric CDS Platform
report.scope_note: Every line of clinical governance machinery the platform needs to be defensible now exists. Almost none of it is visible to a clinician, and no second module has reached the browser. This is the map of what shipped, what's blocked on humans, and what isn't — with a copyable handoff on every item.

items.title: Repair the red check gate
items.note: All 11 growth + 12 kidney evidence passages miss six EPR3 schema fields; rights ledger empty for both modules.

handoff.prompt: Regenerate growth_suite_v1 and kidney_suite_v1 evidence.json against the current evidence.schema.json and backfill rights/rights-ledger.json. Never invent field values — mark unresolved fields explicitly. npm run check must be green before commit.

items.title: Land the git-signed clinical review workflow
items.note: Branch is 30 commits ahead: phases 1, 2, 4 complete, 3 in progress, 5 pending. Main reads 0/5 only because it is unmerged.

handoff.prompt: From worktree-exec-clinical-review-workflow, finish phase 3 (render queue/turn-state) and phase 5, then open a PR to main. Re-run npm run check against current main before merging.

items.title: Module switcher — render any module in the SPA
items.note: The gap. Runtime has been module-agnostic since P0; the browser has never used it.

handoff.prompt: Scope a module selector that renders any modules/<id>/ package behind an unmissable 'unsigned proposal · not clinically reviewed' banner. This is the highest-leverage screen: it makes eight days of invisible platform work perceptible.

items.title: G0 — ADR ratification (8 ADRs, none accepted)
items.note: Each ADR clears G0 on its own; partial ratification is real. No agent, council, or /create-adr invocation can perform this act.

handoff.prompt: Each ADR's named deciders (clinical-governance and platform-engineering leads) must independently change status to accepted in the ADR file itself. No agent may perform this. Route the cleared decision through op.

items.title: Browser-local longitudinal workspace + referral packet
items.note: The monetizable layer. A browser-local slice needs no gate; server-side state opens HIPAA scope.

handoff.trigger: Deferred until the module switcher lands and a second module renders; re-enter to test the commercial thesis before committing to the clinical-review pipeline.
handoff.prompt: Scope a localStorage-only case timeline, unresolved-abnormality list, and printable referral packet. Preserve the browser-only invariant in docs/architecture.md section 4 — no server, no PHI.
